📚 GCSE results day is Thursday, and for the first time grades will appear on a new mobile app. It sounds like progress, but the app won't show results until 11am, three hours after pupils in school get theirs.

Campaigners warn the rollout risks excluding pupils without reliable phone or data access. Ministers should fix teacher shortages and the attainment gap, not just launch an app.
